description: Lists the product's published capabilities with their promise and proof page, the problems it solves, what the plan includes and the published comparison pages, ranked by the need given. Use it when the buyer must choose or asks why this product: what does it do best, is it right for our need. To compare with a named tool, use comparer; for one feature, chercher; for prices, voir_offres. Facts about this product only: about other tools, only what the comparison pages publish.

besoin.description: The buyer's need or criteria, in their words (e.g. read tracking, tenders). Ranks the capabilities.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

name: atouts
title: What the product does best
